text: dsh-chapters 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的长期对话记忆插件，通过 chapters preset 接入压缩流程，并注册 agent 工具与 /chapters 命令。它把会话内容按章节归档，支持从目录续接、跨会话搜索历史、保存子 agent 产出，并将知识库与 Git 或 TreeDX 远端同步。用户还可管理规则、查看归档状态和生成提示建议。适合需要保留长程开发上下文并在后续会话检索的 DSH 用户；可关闭模型增强以使用确定性归档。

dsh-chapters adds long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness. Its preset archives conversations for search and table-of-contents continuations. Agent tools save subagent work, manage rules, and sync knowledge through Git or TreeDX. Model enrichment is optional.

dsh-chapters 的功能「章节归档」：插件把会话事件组织为可持久保存的章节，并在需要时分段；内容可供后续搜索和续接。
dsh-chapters 的功能「目录续接」：压缩流程可用章节目录和引用继续会话，让模型按需读取归档内容，而不是把全部历史塞回上下文。
dsh-chapters 的功能「历史搜索」：agent 可调用 chapters_search 按主题或关键词查找已归档内容，并获得可打开的结果路径。
dsh-chapters 的功能「知识库同步」：插件支持配置知识库远端，并通过 Git 或 TreeDX provider 同步共享知识内容。
dsh-chapters 的功能「Agent 规则管理」：工具接口支持提出规则并查询规则，使归档知识可沉淀为后续会话使用的 agent 指引。

text: @fractalsynapse/dsh-chapters README · Developing / contributing：Three ways to set up a development environment — pick whichever fits your workflow:

@fractalsynapse/dsh-chapters README · Developing / contributing：| Mode | Best for | Command |
|------|----------|---------|
| **Centralized** (your live profile) | Day-to-day development on your main machine | `./dev/install/install.sh && dsh web` |
| **Compartmentalized** (isolated DSH_HOME) | Testing changes without touching your live sessions | `DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-dev ./dev/install/install.sh` |
| **Containerized** (full stack) | Isolated platform with vLLM + Playwright + Chromium | `cd dev/install && docker compose up -d` |

@fractalsynapse/dsh-chapters README · Developing / contributing：All three install the same plugin set: dsh-chapters, [dsh-codegraph](https://github.com/jiangzhenguo/dsh-codegraph)
(structural code search via pre-indexed AST graph), and dsh-tinyfish-search. Full details in
[`dev/install/README.md`](dev/install/README.md). The containerized stack additionally ships its own
vLLM model server (Qwen3-4B-AWQ with inference + systemone endpoints), a DSH Web UI service, and a
CI-capable test runner — everything runs locally with no external API keys required.
@fractalsynapse/dsh-chapters README · Developing / contributing：The site's Part VI covers the daily loop; the repository itself holds the engineering truth for agents:

@fractalsynapse/dsh-chapters README · Developing / contributing：- **[`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)** — working spec for AI agents developing this repo (invariants, budget, hard rules)
- **[`docs/`](docs/)** — deep specs: `contract.md` (host API facts), `architecture.md` (mechanics), `development.md` (build/test loop + tape system), `verify.md` (every claim's procedure), `knowledge-repo.md` (design record), `host-compaction-seam.md`, `provider.md`
- **[`dev/install/`](dev/install/)** — installer, containerized platform, and local-llm skill
- **benchmarks**: `npm run bench` — three arms, local model, never CI ([protocol](benchmarks/README.md))
